allClear.reason: This conclusion covers only the data sources that are connected. Anything not ingested is not counted — see Data freshness below.
allClear.title: Nothing needs attention right now

certScopeNote: "Certificates issued by us" counts only ACME-issued or hand-registered ones. Certificates actually serving traffic are a separate scope (probed from the domain and CDN side) — see "Expiry inspection" on the Certificates page.

error.title: Could not load the situation overview

freshnessHint: The inventory is a snapshot, not live. Every number above is as of these timestamps.

item.domainsExpiring: Domains expiring within 30 days — renewal costs money and expiry is irreversible
item.nodesStale: Nodes unreachable — status cannot be trusted
item.tasksNeverRan: Scheduled jobs that have never run — everything depending on them is empty

notCountedNote_one: {{count}} check could not be counted. That is not zero — we simply did not see it this time. Fix the data source before trusting this page.
notCountedNote_other: {{count}} checks could not be counted. Those are not zero — we simply did not see them this time. Fix the data sources before trusting this page.
onlineCertOk: No probed live certificates are expired or expiring within 30 days
onlineCertUnprobed: {{n}} live certificates have never been probed, so their expiry dates are unknown — "nothing expiring" does not hold. Enable "Certificate expiry check (443)" under Operations → Scheduled tasks.
staleHint: {{actual}} without an update (threshold {{hours}}h) — data may be stale
